features.description: Expanded canonical operational skills matrix to 48 competencies across Cloudflare, Tailnet, GCP, Meta, AI Agents, Microservices, and Databases with dynamic registry synchronizer.
Token reduction toolkit including AST code skeletonizing, JSON smart crusher, log noise pruner, and Ponytail YAGNI minimal code decision ladder.
Evidence-first verification gate (SHA-256 receipts), prospective pre-mortem risk analyzer, and Architectural Decision Record (ADR) scaffolding.
Three-tier architecture uniting Cloudflare Edge Ingress, Tailnet WireGuard Private Mesh, and compute nodes with Zero Public Attack Surface.
Cold vault backup engine with cryptographic validation (SHA-256), PostgreSQL logical dumps via Tailscale SSH, and automated retention rotation.
Continuous health monitoring with self-healing auto-fix and Windows Task Scheduler daemons.
